buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: Neither player has a fatigue edge. Workloads are close, 40 games for Medvedev against 35 for Tiafoe over 14 days, and neither shows a rest or rhythm problem. They last played 2 and 1 days ago respectively.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: Medvedev holds a clear advantage on motivation and pressure. Medvedev is on the way up (+80 Elo over 90 days) while Tiafoe has been sliding (-12). Recent form sits 2 pts below Medvedev's season win rate, against 27 pts below Tiafoe's.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: Conditions point fairly clearly to Medvedev. Both rate below their overall level on Indoor Hard, but Medvedev holds up better (-31 Elo against -71 for Tiafoe). Medvedev is the more proven player on Indoor Hard: 75% wins in 12 months against 64% for Tiafoe. Played indoors, so weather is not a factor.
